decisions: Mini VoiceOver reproduces the original VoiceOver ordering for selected disabled expanded checkbox-button: name, dimmed expanded, button; no trailing group suffix.
Mini VoiceOver reproduces named region start/end: Alpha sharing, region and end of, Alpha sharing, region.
Mini VoiceOver reproduces collapsed checkbox-button output without trailing group suffix; engine currently appends group and emits extra wrapper group stops.
Runner reduced HTML hidden-text output is not used as source of truth because the reducer dropped the CSS hidden class.
No reusable engine, scanner, site fixture, raw artifact, refinedAnnouncements, docs, or promoted fixture files were modified.
supportedScope: Generic checkbox input role=button controls with aria-expanded true/false and aria-label/aria-controls.
Selected expanded control with checked+disabled maps to VoiceOver state order 'dimmed expanded, button'.
Named role=region whose aria-labelledby points at the controlling input should announce region name at start and end.
Do not emit trailing group suffix for these controls solely because of adjacent label/wrapper/aria-live DOM.
limitations: Mini AX tree and step snapshots were empty, so Phase D should use original site AX evidence plus focused unit tests rather than treating this mini artifact as complete AX proof.
Do not generalize to unrelated native button, disclosure, details/summary, carousel, or Dropbox selector/text/layout rules.
handoffReason: Return the narrow checkbox-button/group/region state-order contract to Phase D with focused unit coverage; fixture evidence is not the blocker for this family.
